talks.title: Zeta functions of modular curves and abstract isogeny graphs
talks.speaker: Travis Morrison
talks.abstract: Isogeny graphs of supersingular elliptic curves have broad application, from the study and computation of modular forms to post-quantum cryptography.

talks.title: 3d mirror symmetry and bow varieties
talks.speaker: Tommaso Botta
talks.abstract: As advocated by Aganagic and Okounkov, mirror symmetry in three dimensions admits an enumerative interpretation in terms of quasimap counts to mirror dual symplectic varieties.

talks.title: An Exploration of Sato-Tate Groups of Curves
talks.speaker: Heidi Goodson
talks.affiliation: Brooklyn College and CUNY Graduate Center
talks.abstract: The focus of this talk is on families of curves and their associated Sato-Tate groups - compact Lie groups predicted to determine the limiting distributions of coefficients of the normalized L-polynomials of the curves.

talks.title: A volcanic approach to torsion of CM elliptic curves
talks.speaker: Freddy Saia
talks.abstract: A celebrated theorem of Merel states that for any fixed degree d, there are only finitely many groups which can arise as the torsion subgroup of an elliptic curve over a number field of degree d.

talks.title: Geometric and cohomological properties of Bialynicki-Birula decompositions
talks.speaker: Chayim Lowen
talks.abstract: A celebrated result of Bialynicki-Birula states that a smooth complete Gm-variety with finite fixed locus admits a pair of pavings by so-called stable and unstable Gm-subvarieties.

talks.title: Proving two matrices are inverses using pictures
talks.speaker: Aditya Khanna
talks.abstract: Many objects in combinatorics can be constructed recursively, and we can associate signed weights to these constructed objects.

talks.title: On Generating Maximal Orders in the Endomorphism Algebra of a Supersingular Elliptic Curve
talks.speaker: Will Mahaney
talks.abstract: The endomorphism ring of a supersingular elliptic curve is a maximal order in the definite quaternion algebra over Q ramified at a prime p.

talks.title: Multiline queue crystals and Demazure atom positivity
talks.speaker: Olya Mandelshtam
talks.abstract: Crystal techniques are a standard tool for proving Schur positivity. Can they also be used to study Demazure atom positivity, where the Demazure atoms are the nonsymmetric pieces of Schur polynomials?
